files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: get_customer_by_phone
tool_schemas.description: Looks up the customer record associated with the provided phone number and returns the matching customer when found. The request is refused if the phone number is missing/blank, not in an acceptable phone-number format, or does not match any customer’s primary contact number or any active line number on the account.

phone_number.description: The phone number to search for.
phone_number.title: Phone Number

tool_schemas.name: get_customer_by_id
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves and returns the customer record for the specified customer_id. The request is refused if customer_id is missing/blank or does not correspond to an existing customer.

customer_id.description: The unique identifier of the customer.
customer_id.title: Customer Id

tool_schemas.name: get_customer_by_name
tool_schemas.description: Searches for customers by full name and date of birth and returns any matching customer records (which may be more than one when names are similar). The request is refused if full_name or dob is missing/blank, if dob is not in YYYY-MM-DD format, or if no customers match the provided name and DOB combination.

full_name.description: The full name of the customer.
full_name.title: Full Name

dob.description: Date of birth for verification, in the format YYYY-MM-DD.
dob.title: Dob

tool_schemas.name: get_details_by_id
tool_schemas.description: Returns the full details for the object identified by id when it refers to a Customer, Line, Device, Bill, or Plan. The request is refused if id is missing/blank, if the id is not a recognized identifier for a supported object type, or if no object exists for that id.

id.description: The ID of the object to retrieve.
id.title: Id

tool_schemas.name: suspend_line
tool_schemas.description: Suspends the specified line for the given customer and returns the updated line details with its status set to Suspended and a recorded suspension start date. The request is refused if customer_id, line_id, or reason is missing/blank, if the line does not belong to the customer, or if the line is not currently in Active status (including cases where it is already suspended).

customer_id.description: ID of the customer who owns the line.
customer_id.title: Customer Id

line_id.description: ID of the line to suspend.
line_id.title: Line Id

tool_schemas.name: resume_line
tool_schemas.description: Resumes service on the specified line for the given customer and returns the updated line details with its status set to Active and any suspension start date cleared. The request is refused if customer_id or line_id is missing/blank, if the line does not belong to the customer, or if the line is not currently in Suspended or Pending Activation status.

customer_id.description: ID of the customer who owns the line.
customer_id.title: Customer Id

line_id.description: ID of the line to resume.
line_id.title: Line Id

tool_schemas.name: get_bills_for_customer
tool_schemas.description: Returns a list of bills for the specified customer ordered from most recent to oldest, honoring the provided limit (default 12). The request is refused if customer_id is missing/blank or does not correspond to an existing customer, or if limit is provided but is not a valid integer.

limit.description: Maximum number of bills to return.
limit.title: Limit

tool_schemas.name: send_payment_request
tool_schemas.description: Marks the specified bill as awaiting payment and sends a payment request notification to the customer, returning the updated bill details. The request is refused if the customer or bill cannot be found, if the bill does not belong to the customer, or if the customer already has another bill in an awaiting-payment state (to prevent multiple concurrent payment requests).

customer_id.description: ID of the customer who owns the bill.
customer_id.title: Customer Id

bill_id.description: ID of the bill to send payment request for.
bill_id.title: Bill Id

tool_schemas.name: get_data_usage
tool_schemas.description:
Retrieves current billing cycle data usage for a line, including data

refueling amount, data limit, and cycle end date.

customer_id.description: ID of the customer who owns the line.
customer_id.title: Customer Id

line_id.description: ID of the line to check usage for.
line_id.title: Line Id

tool_schemas.name: enable_roaming
tool_schemas.description: Enables international roaming on the specified line and returns the updated line details reflecting roaming as enabled. The request is refused if customer_id or line_id is missing/blank, if the line does not belong to the customer, or if the line cannot be updated due to its current state (for example, a non-existent or inactive line).

customer_id.description: ID of the customer who owns the line.
customer_id.title: Customer Id

line_id.description: ID of the line to enable roaming for.
line_id.title: Line Id

tool_schemas.name: disable_roaming
tool_schemas.description: Disables international roaming on the specified line and returns the updated line details reflecting roaming as disabled. The request is refused if customer_id or line_id is missing/blank, if the line does not belong to the customer, or if the line cannot be updated due to its current state (for example, a non-existent or inactive line).

customer_id.description: ID of the customer who owns the line.
customer_id.title: Customer Id

line_id.description: ID of the line to disable roaming for.
line_id.title: Line Id

tool_schemas.name: transfer_to_human_agents
tool_schemas.description: Transfers the conversation to a human agent and forwards the provided summary of the user’s issue to assist with handoff. Returns confirmation that the transfer request was created/queued. Refuses requests that do not include a non-empty summary, or when the user has not explicitly asked for a human agent and the issue can be resolved with available tools and policy.

summary.description: A summary of the user's issue.
summary.title: Summary

tool_schemas.name: refuel_data
tool_schemas.description: Adds the specified number of gigabytes to the given line and applies the corresponding refuel charge to the customer’s bill based on the customer’s plan refueling rate. Returns the updated line data balance and the billed charge (or equivalent transaction confirmation) for the refuel. Refuses requests when the customer_id does not own the line, when the line is not in Active status, when identifiers are missing/invalid, or when gb_amount is not a positive number.

customer_id.description: ID of the customer who owns the line.
customer_id.title: Customer Id

line_id.description: ID of the line to refuel data for.
line_id.title: Line Id

gb_amount.description: Amount of data to add in gigabytes.
gb_amount.title: Gb Amount

metadata.name: SignalSure Account Console
metadata.description: Provides customer lookup and full mobile account servicing—plans, lines, devices, billing, usage, roaming controls, data top-ups, payments, and escalations to human agents—via a unified API.
